s: Din pores al shema ubo t' seipim: im yesh bene adam shehitpalelu kol echad bipne atzmo beyachid velo shameu lo qaddish velo qedushsha — omed echad mehem veomer qaddish u"bareku" uberaka rishona shel qeriat shema shehu "yotzer or" paam sheniyya (ushear hatztzibbur shomein veonin amen) (mittaam shennitbaer besiman n"z). Veinyan zeh niqra "pores al shema", pores milleshon chatika, kemo perusa, sheen omerin ella miqtzat mibbirkoteha. Uleachar shessiyyemu birkat "yotzer or" — omer birkat "abot" u"geburot" uqedushsha ve"atta qadosh". Vezeh niqra ober lipne hatteba. Veen osim debarim ellu bepachot measara, mippene shehem debarim shebbiqqedushsha. Vehashshomeim rashshaim laleket ledarkam achar qedushsha, abal haober lipne hatteba tzarik ligmor kol hattepilla, ap al pi shekkebar hitpallel leatzmo, sheasur lehapsiq bitpillat y"ch, sheeno domeh lebirk[o]t qeriat shema shehu mapsiq bahen, veeno omer ella birkat "yotzer or" bilbaddah, hoil ukebar qara leatzmo techilla qeriat shema ubirkoteha, lepi shebbirkot qeriat shema en lahem seder, shessidran eno meakkeb, lepi sheenan nitlot zo bazo sheyyitztarek lesadder zo achar zo, laken rashshay lehapsiq benehem im kebar yatza yede chobato, abal birkot hattepilla yesh lahem seder shetiqqenu lesadderan zo achar zo, veim shinna sidran — tzarik lachazor lerosh lessadderan al hasseder, lepi shekkullan nitlot zo bazo keseder sheqqabeu chakamim, lepikak kevan shehitchil bemiqtzatam — tzarik ligmor et kullan kemo shehen sedurot zo achar zo, ap al pi shekkebar yatza yede chobato:

Veyesh omerim shehappores al shema hu kesheadayin lo qareu qeriat shema ubirkoteha, sheaz omer echad mehem qaddish u"bareku" umebarek birkot shema, vehem shomein veonin acharayv amen veyotzeim yede chobatan (ulepikak gam ken lo haya yakol qatan lipros al shema, shekkol sheeno mechuyyab — eno motzi yede choba). V"pores" hu leshon perusa vehatztzaa, vehu kinnuy lekol mah sheppores umesadder lipne qeriat shema (veachareha), dehaynu qaddish u"bareku" ubirkot qeriat shema. "Ki hu yebarek hazzebach" tirgumo "are hu yipros zebacha". Vetiqqenu ken kede lehotzi et mi sheeno baqi, kemo shetiqqenu battepilla. Abal akshav shekkullam beqiim vekol echad mebarek leatzmo — day beqaddish u"bareku" bilbad, vekol echad mebarek leatzmo achar kak birkot qeriat shema. Veim kebar qareu qeriat shema ubirkoteha — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek apillu beraka rishona, lo happores velo hashshomeim (ulepikak gam ken qatan yakol lipros (mimmah) [kemo] shennitbaer besiman n"g). Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu:

Yesh omerim shepporesin al shema bearbit kemo beshacharit. Ubimdinot ellu nahagu lehaqel bearbit, lepi sheen omerim qaddish bearbit qodem "bareku", umishshum "bareku" bilbad en maqpidin kol kak (umikkol maqom im echad rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo velipros bearbit — en mochin beyado, vetabo alayv beraka):

Mi shello shema qaddish u"bareku" uqedushsha verotzeh lipros al shema o lered lipne hatteba, ap al pi sheyyesh bebet hakkeneset asara — tzarik lachazor achar shishsha shello shameu adayin, dehaynu chamishsha vehu, kede sheyyihyu rob hamminyan meotam shello shameu. Veyesh omerim sheapillu t' sheshshameu mitztorpim leechad shello shama sheyyukal lipros velered lipne hatteba, shekkevan shehem shomeim ledabar shebbiqdushsha shemmotzi bepiv veonin acharayv — hare hu meqaddesh Hashem baasara. Uleinyan maaseh — yesh lachazor lekattechilla achar shishsha shello shameu, veim enam nimtzaim — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona. Uledibre hakkol en tzarik shemmi shello shama yipros beatzmo, ella apillu mi sheshshama kebar yakol lipros velaabor lipne hatteba bishbilo, kemo shehu bekol hammitzvot hatteluyot bedibbur o bishmia, shekkol mi shemmechuyyab baddabar ap al pi sheyyatza kebar yede chobato yakol lehotzi acherim yede chobatan, sheyyomar hu vehem yishmeu mimmennu, sheshshomea keoneh. Umikkol maqom, im oto shello shama hu baqi lipros velaabor lipne hatteba — mutab sheyyipros veyaabor hu mishsheyyipros veyaabor acher shekkebar shama veyatza yede chobato, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"g leinyan qiddush. Veakshav nahagu shelleolam haabelim poresim shema vaapillu shameu veyesh acher shello shama veyodea lipros beatzmo, veen minhag zeh nakon. Veyesh meqomot shennohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur omer "bareku" bekol yom achar qaddish haacharon, kede lehotzi mi shemmitacher labo lebet hakkeneset velo shama adayin "bareku". Veap im era shello ba adam lebet hakkeneset achar "bareku" — en medaqdeqim bekak lebad mishshabbatot veyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"g. Veen lebattel minhagam bebet hakkeneset, mippene hammachaloqet. Abal bebet hammidrash sheen lachush lemachaloqet — yesh linhog shello yomar hashsheliach tzibbur "bareku", ella im ken ba echad achar "bareku". Abal kol mi shehaya bishat amirat "bareku" veshama veana im hatztzibbur, ap shello berak "yotzer or" im hatztzibbur mippene sheheerik beseder hattamid ubipsuqe dezimra veyitztarek lomar "yotzer or" beyachid, ap al pi sheeno rashshay, shehaya lo ledalleg pesuqe dezimra kede lehitpallel im hatztzibbur — en lishliach tzibbur lomar bareku bishbilo (im hu adayin lo higgia le"yotzer or"), hoil vehu kebar shama veana achar "bareku" im hatztzibbur. Vehu haddin im shama "bareku" meechad mehaolim liqrot beseper tora beyom hakkenisa veana acharayv — dayyo, veen hashliach tzibbur chozer bishbilo (im lo higgia adayin le"yotzer or"). Abal keshemmaggia le"yotzer or" — yakol lomar qaddish u"bareku" im mazmin lo t' sheyyishmeu veyaanu acharayv. Veap al pi shekkebar shama veana im hatztzibbur (vegam hem shameu veanu), mikkol maqom kevan sheakshav hu ba lismok le"yotzer or" — yakol lachazor uleomro (vehu haddin sheim higgia le"yotzer or" keshehashsheliach tzibbur higgia leqaddish acharon — chozer hashliach tzibbur "bareku" bishbilo). Veken tzarik lizzaher bimdinot ellu shehaabelim poresim shema, shello yipresu bishbil mi sheshshama bareku apillu mehaechad haolin leseper tora (ella im ken ba lismok "bareku" le"yotzer or"). Nohagin lipros shema achar tepillat y"ch belachash mittaam shennitbaer besiman n"d, vekol otam shello shameu bareku mitqabbetzim az lepetach bet hakkeneset etzel haabelim, shehem poresim shema venimshak mizzeh qilqul sheadayin miqtzat haqqahal mitpalelim veellu oberin lipnehem, veasur laabor keneged hammitpalelin. Al ken tzarik lizzaher bazeh:

Ap al pi sheapillu yachid shehitpallel kebar bipne atzmo ella shello shama qedushsha yakol lered lipne hatteba velachazor ulehitpallel kol hattepilla bishbil haqqedushsha, mikkol maqom im lo hitpallel adayin — en lo lehitpallel belachash techilla ella im ken yesh shishsha shehem rob minyan shello hitpalelu adayin sheaz hem kemo tzibbur gamur, umitpalelim belachash techilla veachar kak chozer echad mehem hattepilla beqol ram, im yesh t' sheyyishmeu veyaanu amen. Abal bepachot mishshishsha shello hitpalelu — lo yitpallel hashsheliach tzibbur belachash techilla, apillu hashsheliach tzibbur hu meotan shello hitpalelu adayin, ella yatchil miyyad beqol ram, shehare iqqar hakkavvana hu bishbil haqqedushsha (umittaam zeh lo yomar beqol ram ella ad "hael haqqadosh" velo yoter, shello hittiru lehashmia qolo bitpillato ella bachazarat hashsheliach tzibbur bilbad, vezeh eno sheliach tzibbur kevan sheeno rashshay lachazor hattepilla, veeno mitpallel ella paam achat bishbil chobat atzmo bilbad):

Mi shennitacher labo lebet hakkeneset velo shama lo "bareku" velo qedushsha, vechoshesh shemma lo yihyu asara bebet hakkeneset kesheyyaggia litpilla — yesh mattirin sheyyipros veyaabor lipne hatteba lehitpallel shemoneh esreh miyyad veachar kak yiqra qeriat shema ubirkoteha, velo yachazor lehitpallel. Veap al pi sheeno somek geulla litpilla — en bekak kelum, hoil vekavvanato lomar qedusha baasara. Veen lehaqel bazeh lekattechilla, ella yitpallel kasseder veyismok geulla litpilla. Veim yihyeh asara bebet hakkeneset — yomar qedushsha, sheen lehapsiq ben geulla litpilla mishshum qedushsha (kemo shennitbaer besiman s"v):

Asur lishliach tzibbur o leacher lehapsiq ben geulla litpilla shel shacharit o biqriat shema ubirkoteha kede lipros al shema leotam shebbau lebet hakkeneset leachar sheanu haqqahal qaddish u"bareku" vehitchil kebar hashsheliach tzibbur bebirkat "yotzer or", abal im adayin lo hitchil — chozer veomer "bareku" paam shenit bishbil otam shebbau leachar sheanu haqqahal "bareku". Abal ben geulla litpilla shel arbit — muttar lehapsiq lehotzi acherim yede chobatan be"bareku", shehare belo zeh mapsiqin ben geulla litpilla bipsuqim veqaddish hoil utepillat arbit reshut, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"v:

Yesh mi sheomer sheim hitpalelu tzibbur bebet hakkeneset ubau tzibbur acher lachazor ulehitpallel keseder tepillat tzibbur sheyyaabor echad mehem lipne hatteba lehotzi acherim yede chobatan bidbarim shebbiqqedushsha — en lishliach tzibbur hashsheni laamod bemaqom sheamad harishon, im harishonim adayin bebet hakkeneset ella shehishlimu sidram, ki zeh genay larishonim keillu lo yatzeu yede chobatan barishona veomed zeh lehotziam yede chobatan. Abal im yatzeu harishonim mibbet hakkeneset — en lachush lazeh. Veim en sheliach tzibbur laacharonim — yakol apillu sheliach tzibbur harishonim lered lipne hatteba shenit lehotziam yede chobatan (bidbarim shebbiqdushsha, veyakol lachazor ulehitpallel lahem kol tepillat y"ch bishbil haqqedushsha shebbah kemo shennitbaer, abal lo tepillat lachash, velo "yishtabbach" ubirkot qeriat shema, shekkullam beqiim vekol echad mebarek leatzmo). Veim harishonim hotziu seper tora veqareu bo — nohagim biqtzat meqomot sheen haacharonim motziim seper tora shenit liqrot beoto bet hakkeneset. Veyesh shennatenu taam leminhagam shehu mishshum pegamo shel seper tora, shemma yomru shemmatzeu pesul beseper tora rishona umippene kak hotziu seper tora sheniyya. Veap im hu seper tora ha' atzmo, mikkol maqom harishonim en makkirin otah, veshemma yomru shehi seper tora acheret shehotziu mishshum pesul shemmatzeu barishona (abal min haddin en shum issur baddabar, sheen lachush lipgamo shel rishona ella kesheoleh liqrot bashsheniyya mi sheala kebar barishona, vegam bazeh en lachush ella kesheoleh veqore bishnehem zeh achar zeh miyyad beli hepseq ish benetayim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qm"d, vekol shekken kan shemmapsiqin benetayim harbeh vegam hu tzibbur acher, shebbevadday en lachush liklum):

Suma ap al pi shello raa meorot miyyamayv — yakol lipros al shema, apillu bizman shehappores haya mebarek gam "yotzer hammeorot" lehotzi acherim yede chobatan, mippene sheggam hu chayyab bebirkat "yotzer hammeorot" kemo acherim happiqchim, lepi shehu neheneh bimorot sheroin happiqchin, sheyyukelu liroto ulehorot oto hadderek asher yelek bah:
